exposure: Test of Infant Motor Performance (TIMP) assessed at term equivalent age (TEA)
Test of Infant Motor Performance (TIMP) assessed at 3 months corrected age (CA)
outcome: neurodevelopmental impairments (assessed by Alberta Infant Motor Scale (AIMS), Neurological Sensory Motor Development Assessment (NSMDA), and Bayley Scale of Infant and Toddler Development 3rd edition (Bayley III))
cohort: The study recruited 202 infants born very preterm (VPT) at less than 31 weeks gestational age.
finding: The TIMP assessed at TEA and 3 months CA correctly identified the majority of VPT infants without motor and cognitive impairments, but it missed those who developed adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes by 12 months CA.
